dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Saints (3-7) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Bengals
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Kellen Moore and the medical staff evaluate OT Asim Richards (knee), CB Martin Emerson Jr. (concussion), OT Taliese Fuaga (knee), and C Erik McCoy (biceps) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report [Wallace Delery](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-news/118490/nfl-picks-week-12-thanks-for-nothing).

Week 12 Bengals Outlook: Kellen Moore and DC Brandon Staley open installation for the Cincinnati Bengals (7-3, CIN -10, HC Zac Taylor, OC Dan Pitcher & DC Al Golden (Road Test))—a unit ranked #1 in Passing Yards / Game (297.1 yds) as New Orleans prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Wallace Delery](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-news/118490/nfl-picks-week-12-thanks-for-nothing) [neworleanssaints.com Official](https://www.neworleanssaints.com/news/cincinnati-bengals-vs-new-orleans-saints-game-preview-2026-nfl-season-week-12-series-history-stats-connections).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 3-7 (3rd in NFC South • #14 Seed in NFC), New Orleans carries a 7.4% postseason projection, 7.4% NFC South division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [Caleb Yaccarino](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-power-rankings/118504/saints-power-rankings-nfl-week-11).

Around the Beat: Why Field Yates is banking on Jordyn Tyson to bounce back [Saints Beat Wire](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/4880281/jordyn-tyson#:~:text=Why%20Field%20Yates%20is%20banking%20on%20Jordyn).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, New Orleans ranks #21 in Points / Game (21.5), #23 in Points Allowed / Game (25.7), #29 in Turnover Differential (-8), giving Kellen Moore and Brandon Staley a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 12:00 PM CST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Cincinnati Bengals [Caleb Yaccarino](https://www.canalstreetchronicles.com/new-orleans-saints-power-rankings/118504/saints-power-rankings-nfl-week-11).
